notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.1.5
notes.content:
Interface
Updated copyright details on the menu
New UI for login, server selection, character select, and character creation
Enhanced various aspects of the character creation process
The player's "paper doll" will now animate correctly on the equipment screen

Mechanics
Slightly reduced player movement speed
Player's will now lose a small amount of experience on death (Starting at level 3), also making it possible to lose levels
You can no longer camp out while swimming
Player's graves can now be inspected to see who died there

Client
Added a new command '/time' to get the current time in Avalon
Added a new command '/discord' which will open the game's discord server.
New player models have been added that are more detailed. This is the first update for them, and we will continue to roll out more updates for them including armor / weapons.
General improvements to lighting
Added a new anti-aliasing option in the options menu 
Added a new 'crosshair' setting in the options menu
Monsters will now add a message to the event window when they begin to flee
General performance improvements for client performance
Improved asset loading times

tags.bug: The player's "paper doll" will now animate correctly on the equipment screen

tags.feature: Player's graves can now be inspected to see who died there
Added a new command '/time' to get the current time in Avalon
Added a new command '/discord' which will open the game's discord server.
New player models have been added that are more detailed.
Added a new anti-aliasing option in the options menu
Added a new 'crosshair' setting in the options menu
Monsters will now add a message to the event window when they begin to flee

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.1.4
notes.content:
Interface
Updated copyright details on the menu
Spell selection will now persist through zoning and even logging in / out
Fixed an edge case where the spells list wouldn't correctly update after learning a spell

Server
Correct the calculation for mana regeneration while standing (it was incorrectly using stamina before)
Fixed issue where corpses could sometimes not be looted in liquids
No drop items can no longer be traded
Fixed an issue where you could receive unique items in a trade if you already had one

Items
Sabatons of Egress should now have the correct 'use' effect
Gloves of Invisibility should now have the correct 'use' effect

Client
Fixed an edge case for glitchy pathing
Corrected a rare client-side problem with corpses moving after death

Quests

Server
Fixed several situations where creatures could become 'stuck' in the same place for long periods

Client
Added support for banking
Added /auction and /ooc chat channels

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.1.0
notes.content:
General
- The demo version of Avalon: Sacred Crusade will be released on Steam for public download!

Environment
- 5 new levels added
- A new 'main' quest for the demo that players can complete
- Many new rare drops for the player to discover
- Several new enemies added
- Added lootable chests to the world

Server
- Further improved pathfinding
- Fixed an edge case which prevented looting in a few situations
- Added support for 'locked' objects

Combat
- Tweaked regeneration rates again

Interface
- New look and feel for the UI which better supports many resolutions
- Inventory has been standardized a bit, you can now drag and drop items and also split stacks (with shift + click)

Sounds
- Started revamping some of the sound effects (still a work in progress) (Known issue: some creatures / objects are still missing some sounds)
